text:
Mia: Quick flag — noticed a p99 latency bump on the continuous-batcher when KV hit-rate falls below ~35%. Looks like small batches are getting through with kernel-switch overhead and we're seeing tail regressions.
Alex: Can you paste the perf snippet?
Mia: sure
```
p99: 212ms -> 340ms
avg batch size: 6 -> 2.3
kv_hit_rate: 0.41 -> 0.28
kernel_swap_count: +82/min
```
Sanjay: hmm. Two orthogonal pain points: (1) kernel selection thrashes when batch size collapses mid-window, (2) admission lets tiny requests through instead of soft-shedding, so kernels keep swapping.
Chen: agree. Proposal: add a "defer_kernel_swap_window_ms" so we don't swap kernels for short-lived collapses, and tighten token_budget_target to bias admission toward slightly larger batches. Example config: 
```
"continuous_batcher": {
  "token_budget_target": 0.75,
  "min_coalesce_ms": 6,
  "defer_kernel_swap_window_ms": 120
}
"admission": {
  "soft_limit_p95": 0.88,
  "soft_429_probability": 0.12
}
```
Alex: Nice. Defer window avoids flip-flop. For the admission side, I'd prefer a probabilistic pre-shed that increases with queue depth instead of immediate hard 429s — smoother for clients.
Mia: Can we also gate kernel-swap on KV cache trend? If KV hit-rate dropping, favor the low-latency kernel even at cost of throughput. That reduces swapping later.
Sanjay: Good call. Add heuristic: if kv_hit_moving_avg < 0.35 and batch_size < 4 then force low-latency kernel for X seconds. 
linda: Let's be careful about correctness — low-latency kernel changed numeric outputs in past. Need to run eval prompt set to detect regressions. I'll create a small regression job.
infra-bot: Canary cluster "canary-batch-2" deployed config v0.9.3-beta with token_budget_target=0.75 and defer_kernel_swap_window_ms=120. Metrics pipeline: https://grafana/redwood/canary/2111112222
Chen: I'll run 2h canary and collect p50/p95/p99 + quality evals. If p99 drops and eval pass, roll to prod.
Mia: Action items: (1) Chen run canary 2h (2) Linda run eval suite (3) Alex add probabilistic pre-shed curve PR (4) Sanjay add KV gating logic prototype. We'll reconvene after canary. :thumbsup:
Alex: PR coming in ~1h.
Sanjay: I'll sketch the gating rules and tests.
linda: kicked off eval job, ETA 45m.
infra-bot: Canary metrics collected for 10m so far — p99 improved from 340ms -> 268ms at minute 8.
